description: This file defines the MonthField class, which is part of the Cron namespace. It handles parsing, validation, and date calculations related to cron month fields, including special values like '*', '/', and '-'.

classes.name: MonthField
classes.description: A class representing the month part of a cron schedule, capable of evaluating if a date satisfies its condition, incrementing the date to the next or previous month, and validating its input value.

methods.name: isSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the given DateTime object satisfies the month condition based on the value provided.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Advances or regresses the date to the start of the next or previous month based on the invert parameter.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the format of the month cron field string.
